title: Review render-history orbit brightness fix
objective: Review Builder's fix for progressive brightness in scene_off_flashlight_on orbit renders. Verify correctness, risk, tests, and whether the camera-cut render-history reset is a reasonable focused fix.
instructions: Review the Builder ResultPacket and changed files.

Focus on behavioral correctness: CLI default/override semantics, capture loop behavior, whether bCameraCutThisFrame is set at the right time for all capture components, and whether the workflow helper still preserves the active-illumination trio contract.
Check tests for meaningful coverage and run lightweight validation if appropriate.

artifacts: Flashlight orbit renders now default to --disable-render-history, which marks each explicit scene capture as bCameraCutThisFrame to avoid temporal renderer accumulation across orbit frames.

expected_outputs: ResultPacket with findings ordered by severity
definition_of_done: Review findings are clear and actionable.
